Default copper bridge1-2 selects qualified-source operation (good USB OR field power). CUT1-2 before soldering2-3 SERVICE. Never bridge both: U11 output would short 3V3.

USB/field priority mux. Field (IN1) wins whenever valid; USB (IN2) otherwise. Fast 5us switchover in XCOMP mode. Reverse-current blocking keeps field power off the USB host. OV1/OV2 unused (GND); BQ24074 retains its own input OVP.
PR1 divider top: PR1 = 0.301 x 5V_FIELD (1.51 V at 5.0 V).
PR1 divider bottom. Field keeps priority while PR1 > CP2: down to 4.14 V field at 5.00 V USB, 4.35 V at 5.25 V USB.
CP2 divider top: CP2 = 0.249 x VBUS. CP2 >= VREF (fast-switchover XCOMP mode) for VBUS >= 4.41 V.
CP2 divider bottom.

TPS2121 IN2 (USB) local capacitor. USB VBUS total stays below 10 uF.
TPS2121 IN1 (field) local capacitor.
ST pull-up (datasheet 6-20k). High = field/IN1 or no output, low = USB/IN2.
Open by default (field priority). Bridge for bench work to make USB win whenever valid; with USB absent the field input still powers the board.

AND-OR: SOURCE_QUALIFIED = (FIELD_PG AND PWR_SRC) OR USB_HIGH_CURRENT. Field qualifies only while U10 actually selects IN1 (ST high), so JP2/USB-priority on a weak USB port can no longer select BQ ILIM. TI SCES606: Y=(A.B)+C, inputs 5.5 V tolerant, Ioff.
U11 local decoupling.
FIELD_PG pulldown. Pull-up lives on the interface board from 5V_FIELD, so an absent/unpowered field converter can never qualify a weak USB port.

Board-to-board link to the interface daughterboard (field 12/24 V input, buck, OSDP, Wiegand, tamper, buzzer). Through-hole, body on the back side so the reader stays single-sided SMT. Mates with Samtec CLP-105-02 family; stack height set by case. Land is the KiCad generic 1.27 mm THT header - verify against Samtec drawing.

usb_boot_gate_profile.truth: CHIP_EN = ESP_RESET_RC AND POWER_PERMIT with In1=GND
usb_boot_gate_profile.normal_selector: JP1 copper bridge1-2; USB_HIGH_CURRENT drives POWER_PERMIT
usb_boot_gate_profile.service_selector: Cut1-2 completely before solder bridge2-3; never bridgeboth
usb_boot_gate_profile.future_battery: Normal selector requires USB. Explicit service setting permits experimental battery boot but does not qualify battery charging, NFC TXLDO voltage profile, transient power, or protection.
usb_boot_gate_profile.cold_delay_scope: Empty C9 and valid3V logic step only; retained C9 charge after brief detach may allow immediate release once permission returns.
usb_boot_gate_profile.BQ_mode_settling: No guaranteed BQ EN2 transition bound established; full startup transient model has not completed.

field_power_profile.mux: U10 TPS2121 IN1=5V_FIELD priority, IN2=USB VBUS, XCOMP fast switchover; JP2 bridge = USB priority
field_power_profile.permission: SOURCE_QUALIFIED = (FIELD_PG AND PWR_SRC) OR USB_HIGH_CURRENT (U11 SN74LVC1G0832) -> BQ EN2 and JP1.1
field_power_profile.outline: Grown 6.5 mm on the right edge (x 65.5 -> 72.0) for y 0..37; stops above the Wi-Fi antenna keepout (y >= 38.7). J2 battery connector loses edge access (battery unsupported in v0.5).
field_power_profile.field_pg_qualification: Pull-up from 5V_FIELD on interface board; R37 100k pulldown on main board
field_power_profile.io0: IO_INT shared open-drain interrupt; R10/R11/C8 DNP
field_power_profile.startup_reanalysis_required: C9/R12 reset delay with U11 propagation and TPS2121 tSET/soft start
